question: Livestock and their feed take most of the world's farmland. What share of the world's calories do they supply?
answer: About 18%. Our World in Data, using UN farm statistics, finds livestock, counting pasture and feed land, uses about 77% of the world's farmland yet supplies 18% of its calories and 37% of its protein. Animals burn most of what they eat keeping warm and moving. Most of that land feeds animals, not people.
move: Count what goes into a system, not only what comes out.
ask: Which part of my life takes the most of my time while giving back the least?
trap: About half, since meat and milk fill so many rich-world plates.
